coverageNotes: Does not prove that post-filtering reduces scanned rows or handles arbitrarily large result sets.

questions.concept: Filter outside an index range builder
questions.question: Which query expression fits the marked position?

options.rationale: Incorrect: isDeleted is not in by_age, and an equality constraint cannot be appended after this lower bound.

options.text:
```ts
ctx.db.query("users")
  .withIndex("by_age", q => q.gte("age", args.minAge))
  .filter(q => q.eq("isDeleted", false))
```
options.rationale: Incorrect: in a filter, a string is a literal value. q.field("isDeleted") is needed to read a document field.

options.text:
```ts
ctx.db.query("users")
  .filter(q => q.eq(q.field("isDeleted"), false))
  .withIndex("by_age", q => q.gte("age", args.minAge))
```
options.rationale: Incorrect: filter returns a Query, which no longer has the QueryInitializer.withIndex method. Choose the index first.

options.text:
```ts
ctx.db.query("users")
  .withIndex("by_age", q => q.gte("age", args.minAge))
  .filter(q => q.eq(q.field("isDeleted"), false))
```
options.rationale: Correct: the range builder constrains age, and the filter expression reads the nonindexed isDeleted field.
